# Zen Forest

Zen Forest is a minimalist, cinematic writing space built on pure typography and a curated forest colour palette. Headings and body text align to one unified narrow layout, and modal animations are described as fluid. Its recorded description states that the theme is optimized for desktop and that the mobile layout is experimental.

![Zen Forest screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hobbysoftwaredeveloper/Zen-Forest/HEAD/preview/1.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Zen Forest"
    author: "noctivision"
    repo:   "hobbysoftwaredeveloper/Zen-Forest"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/zen-forest"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/hobbysoftwaredeveloper/Zen-Forest"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hobbysoftwaredeveloper/Zen-Forest/HEAD/preview/1.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Transform Obsidian into a minimalist, cinematic writing space with pure typography, a curated forest color palette, and pixel-perfect UI styling. Align headings and body to a unified narrow layout, add fluid modal animations, and optimize for desktop with mobile layout experimental."
}
```
